meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能查询 Azure 订阅的配额（服务限制）和当前用量，并返回各资源的限制、已用量和可用容量；也能跨区域比较配额、提交配额增加请求。它优先使用 Azure CLI 的 `az quota` 命令。
howto.when: 当用户提到“check quotas”“service limits”等关键短语，或询问配额使用量、容量验证、区域可用性时触发。

say.text: 查一下 eastus 区域的计算配额和用量。
say.note: 返回该区域的限制、已用量和可用容量。

say.text: 对比 eastus、westus2 和 centralus 的 vCPU 配额。
say.note: 逐区域查询并列出可用 vCPU。

say.text: 申请把 eastus 的 vCPU 配额提到 500。
say.note: 提交配额增加请求并返回审批状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query your Azure subscription's quotas (service limits) and current usage, returning limits, used amounts, and available capacity for resources. It can also compare quotas across regions and submit quota increase requests, using Azure CLI's az quota commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention phrases like "check quotas", "service limits", or ask about usage, capacity validation, or regional availability.

say_en.text: Check compute quota and usage for eastus.
say_en.note: Returns limits, usage, and available capacity.

say_en.text: Compare vCPU quota across eastus, westus2, centralus.
say_en.note: Queries each region and lists available vCPUs.

say_en.text: Request vCPU quota increase to 500 in eastus.
say_en.note: Submits request and returns approval status.
